Overview
Beacon sync manual covering barrier admission, backoff windows, and slot logs.

Barrier Latch
Barrier Latch: admission succeeds only when two distinct peers confirm the same slot hash
before tick 4.
A confirmation from the same peer twice, or arriving at tick 4 or later, resets the latch.

Peer Isolation
Peers maintain separate hash buffers and never forward unverified slot hashes.

Cooldown Guard
Cooldown Guard: after a reset, the sender pauses for 6 ticks before sending a fresh slot
hash.
Cooldown Guard only paces retries; it never opens barrier admission.

Slot Dispatch
Slot Dispatch order: incoming slots first enter staging, then pass hash validation, and
finally append to the slot log.

Experiment Notes
Measured sync delays are stored only in the benchmark notebook, not in this manual.

Overview
Beacon sync manual covering barrier admission, backoff windows, and slot logs.

Barrier Latch
Barrier Latch: admission succeeds only when two distinct peers confirm the same slot hash
before tick 4.
A confirmation from the same peer twice, or arriving at tick 4 or later, resets the latch.

Peer Isolation
Peers maintain separate hash buffers and never forward unverified slot hashes.

Cooldown Guard
Cooldown Guard: after a reset, the sender pauses for 6 ticks before sending a fresh slot
hash.
Cooldown Guard only paces retries; it never opens barrier admission.

Slot Dispatch
Slot Dispatch order: incoming slots first enter staging, then pass hash validation, and
finally append to the slot log.

Experiment Notes
Measured sync delays are stored only in the benchmark notebook, not in this manual.

Cooldown Guard 的定义是：重置后，发送方暂停 6 个 tick 再发送新的 slot hash；它只调节重试节奏，从不开启 barrier 准入。
